notes.title: Official Announcement Trailer
notes.content:
Good evening everyone,

I hope this post finds you well.

I do apologise for the lack of updates here on the hub!  I have been focusing my free time on making the game and haven't had much time to keep all corners of the internet up to date!  I will make sure this is fixed in the future.

I would like to share with you a new trailer for the game, this trailer shows what I have been working on over the past year and also the first song written specifically for ToaW!  You will see the game has changed a lot over the past year - I hope you like the changes!

Tale Of A Wolf now has a composer, Michael Baugh and will feature an original soundtrack!  This is going to help bring the world of ToaW to another level!

[previewyoutube=JFaWkC5RoD0;full][/previewyoutube]

The Steam page will be getting lots of love over the next 2 weeks, all images will be updated to reflect the current state of the game!

Please do let me know what you think and I look forward to sharing more updates with you!

Best Regards,

Luke

notes.title: Environment & Movement Update Video
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who played the alpha demo for Tale Of A Wolf.  

Over the past 2 weeks I have been working hard to make improvements based on all the feedback I had received.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37405229/463d39f31f80da60b6f7154d0f99f4bf0b4c1e8c.jpg[/img]

The top issues were the movement style & performance of the game, I have made optimisations in as many places as I can and also remade the control system to a more easier to navigate solution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37405229/4b7be9979f5d047bc2077eb99b9679aa96f584a4.jpg[/img]

Previously, you would control your wolf via root motion, this means the motion was baked into the animations and if you would like to turn around, you would literally have to do the full motion and turn around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37405229/729f853f8dc33be7234ec9ebdd3a510707cf9e13.jpg[/img]

I have now replaced the root motion and handle the movement via scripts, this allows for a more responsive controller!

[previewyoutube=0NH9r89atHg;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your time, I look forward to sharing more progress with you in the future!

Best Regards,

Luke

notes.title: Ako's Fire Form Available
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

I have updated the demo so you can now play as Ako's fire form!

The fire form can easily set fire to equipment - no need to pick up anymore branches!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37405229/195546844b8c3a008bed776f864de1c86664511e.jpg[/img]

I have also re enabled reflections for the lake and the day and night cycle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37405229/0e7ac4d4b08e20b1a26d30887eac3b62e3340121.jpg[/img]

I still have many issues to fix, but I am working hard on improving the game overall!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37405229/9d29f96c2d1052509de830a2be01663284991df2.jpg[/img]

I hope you have fun with the new form, please let me know what you think!

Best Regards,

Luke

notes.title: Tale Of A Wolf Demo
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37405229/71dd2d6dcb7c6cef56700c442703200cb451d734.png[/img]

I am happy to announce a short playable experience is now available during the Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition!  The demo will take around 30-45 minutes to complete and is only a small fraction of what is to come!

During the demo you will be helping out Theodore the bear!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37405229/ee26ea1ef4f91673365d133c416f3199104306a5.png[/img]

The humans are hunting animals and trapping them in cages, as their guardian it is your responsibility to protect your fellow animals!  You will have access to Ako's ice form during the demo in order to break the cages that imprison your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37405229/4da43bff01d28fce8b5870005c101c395119580d.png[/img]

Get ready to lead your pack and take on the humans invading Sylvanna!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37405229/9cb43b9c3a0b99576297ad296f1b98b701719c10.png[/img]
